language.label: Language
language.description: Game names, rules, menus and collectibles use this language.

translateCollectibles.label: Translate quotes and chapters
translateCollectibles.description: Show quotes and Tao Te Ching chapters in your language. Turn this off to read them in English.

resumeLastGame.label: Resume game on startup
resumeLastGame.description: Reopen the last game when the app starts.

showAnimations.label: Show animations
showAnimations.description: Weather and scenery effects behind the cards.

showTips.label: Show tips
showTips.description: Show a quick start summary for new games.

keepScreenAwake.label: Keep screen awake
keepScreenAwake.description: Keeps the screen on for 10 minutes after your last touch.

hapticFeedback.label: Haptic feedback
hapticFeedback.description: Vibrates on card drag and drop, and game wins. Haptics must be enabled in your phone settings.
